metadata.description: Agent skills for encrypted messaging, social media automation, and AI budget management

plugins.name: agent-messenger
plugins.description: E2E encrypted agent-to-agent messaging over Nostr using NIP-17 gift wrapping. Send DMs, group messages, manage identities, and run autonomous agent harnesses.

plugins.name: agent-x
plugins.description: Interact with X (Twitter) from the command line — post tweets, search, manage bookmarks, view timelines, and automate social media workflows.

plugins.name: level5
plugins.description: Budget Management for AI Agents — USDC billing gateway. Deposit USDC on Solana; pay for LLM compute per token.

plugins.name: agent-wallet
plugins.description: Solana wallet CLI with automatic HTTP 402 payment handling via the MPP protocol.

plugins.name: agent-dns
plugins.description: MPP-enabled agent-first DNS management and domain registration API. Pay-per-request via Solana USDC.
